capabilities: Sync agent memories into the vault as Markdown notes with type, confidence and provenance frontmatter
Skip locally edited notes on later syncs and list skipped files
Search stored memories in a chat sidebar with recall modes for dates and changes
Answer questions from stored memories and insert results into the current note
Start, stop and connect to a local Memanto server
disambiguation: Not a note-taking or spaced-repetition memory tool; it imports and queries memories created by external coding agents.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Chat requires a desktop client because the local server listens on 127.0.0.1, though synced notes open on mobile. Cloud backend stores memories with the third-party Moorcheh service; on-prem backend keeps everything local via Docker.
problem: Memories that coding agents accumulate (decisions, preferences, facts, mistakes) live inside tools like Claude Code and are not searchable or reusable from the vault.
